## What

Summarize the change and its scope.

## Why

Explain the problem, decision, or desired outcome.

## Risk

Describe compatibility, security, performance, migration, operational, and rollback risks.

## Test

List checks performed and evidence of the result.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to the approved task scope.
- [ ] No `.env`, secret, credential, certificate, log, cache, or private data is included.
- [ ] Relevant tests or validation checks pass.
- [ ] README and affected documentation are updated.
- [ ] CHANGELOG is updated.
- [ ] Architecture impact was assessed and an ADR was added when required.
- [ ] The branch is ready for review; `main` was not modified directly.
